llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: (1) No physical business address, business registration, or verifiable contact information; only a contact form and newsletter option. (2) Generic privacy policy lacking legal information or regulatory compliance. (3) Overuse of psychological trust-building language ('100% safe purchases', 'free shipping', 'SSL security') while having actual SSL issues, contradicting these claims. (4) Website mimics a recognizable brand (TWINSET Milano) without proving any affiliation or legitimacy. (5) Featured products and urgency tactics are typical in fake shopping sites. (6) Absence of any company details is a major red flag. Collectively, these align closely with fake online shopping scam patterns.
